subject: Intro: Ruby Chaudhry (Referral) — ownership & interview scheduling
messages:
From: Samir Iqbal <samir.iqbal@talentreferrals.com>
To: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.ai>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 15 Mar 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Referral: Ruby Chaudhry — strong backend + infra experience

Hi Logan —

Hope you’re well. Quick intro: I’m referring Ruby Chaudhry for the Senior Backend Engineer role (open on your team). Ruby has solid distributed systems experience (3 years at ScaleCo, prior infra at CloudLayer). I’ve attached a short resume and a one-line summary of projects.

Ruby is available for interviews next week during Pacific hours; their preferred window is 10am–3pm PT.

Resume attached: Ruby_Chaudhry_Resume.pdf

Quick ask: can you suggest who should own this referral internally? Happy to coordinate the handoff.

Thanks,
Samir
Samir Iqbal
TalentReferrals (external partner)
From: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.ai>
To: Samir Iqbal <samir.iqbal@talentreferrals.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 15 Mar 2027 10:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Referral: Ruby Chaudhry — strong backend + infra experience

Thanks Samir — really appreciate the intro and the context. I’ve reviewed Ruby’s resume at a glance and it looks like a good fit for the infra team.

Laura — can you pick this up as sourcer/coordination lead (ownership for scheduling and initial screen)? Dev is the hiring manager — I’ve looped him in for role fit and interview panel suggestions.

Proposed next steps:
- Laura to propose 2–3 first-screen slots (10–30 min) next week in PT windows Samir listed
- Dev to confirm interviewers for the screen / take-home (if needed)
- Once slot agreed, send calendar invite and GH candidate link

Samir — we’ll keep you in the loop; Laura may reach out directly to Ruby to finalize times.

Logan Wright
Director, Engineering Hiring
Redwood Inference
From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Ruby Chaudhry <ruby.chaudhry@gmail.com>
Cc: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.ai>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Samir Iqbal <samir.iqbal@talentreferrals.com>
Date: Mon, 15 Mar 2027 11:20:00 -07:00
Subject: Intro + availability: screening for Senior Backend Engineer (Ruby Chaudhry)

Hi Ruby —

Welcome — I’m Laura (recruiter supporting this role). Logan looped me in to coordinate next steps. Thanks Samir for the intro.

I have the following openings next week (all PT):
- Tue 16 Mar: 10:30–11:00, 14:00–14:30
- Wed 17 Mar: 11:00–11:30, 15:00–15:30

The first stage we typically do is a 30-minute phone screen with a recruiter + hiring manager check-in. I’ve attached a short agenda for the initial conversation (initial-interview-AGENDA.docx).

Please let me know which slot works best and I’ll send a calendar invite. If none of these work, paste a couple alternatives and I’ll try to accommodate.

Best,
Laura Bennett
Senior Technical Recruiter
Redwood Inference
Attachment: initial-interview-AGENDA.docx

Subject: Re: Intro + availability: screening for Senior Backend Engineer (Ruby Chaudhry)

Hi Laura and team —

Thanks for reaching out. I can do Tue 16 Mar 14:00–14:30 PT. That works perfectly.

Attached is my resume as well (same as Samir sent) and a quick portfolio link. Looking forward to the conversation.

Ruby Chaudhry
ruby.chaudhry@gmail.com

Date: Tue, 16 Mar 2027 08:00:00 -07:00
Subject: Confirmed: initial screen on Tue 16 Mar 14:00 PT — calendar invite attached

Thanks all — calendar invite sent to Ruby for Tue 16 Mar 14:00–14:30 PT (calendar-invite-Ruby-1.ics). Dev — you’ll be on the screen with me; Vivek will join for a quick 10-minute intro if available.

Logistics / prep:
- Please review the GH candidate card: https://app.greenhouse.io/candidates/RC-4521
- Recruiter screen agenda attached (Laura has the doc)
- If any materials or a short take-home are needed after the screen, flag here by EOD Wed 17 Mar

Ownership note: Laura will own scheduling and candidate communications from here; I’ll own hiring decision coordination and interviewer assignments.

Thanks —
Logan Wright
Director, Engineering Hiring
Redwood Inference

Date: Thu, 18 Mar 2027 09:30:00 -07:00
Subject: Quick update / pre-screen checklist for Ruby (handoff complete)

Thanks team — confirmation that the handoff is clean. Laura has schedule and candidate contact. A couple of quick notes pre-screen:
- Please ask Ruby for a brief walkthrough of the last distributed tracing project (2 slides) — helps assess infra ownership
- If the screen is strong, I’ll send a short coding exercise (max 90 minutes) and propose panel members (2x SDE II + 1x infra lead)

Laura — I’ll defer to you to manage candidate follow-ups and to send the GH next-stage trigger when ready.

Dev Patel
Staff Engineering Manager, Infrastructure
Redwood Inference
